User.title: Username
User.description: Informz username (embedded in SOAP request body as <User> or <Username>).

Password.title: Password
Password.description: Informz password (embedded in SOAP request body as <Password>).

BrandID.title: Brand ID
BrandID.description: Informz Brand ID (numeric value embedded in SOAP request body as <Brand id="NNNN">). Identifies the tenant/organization within Informz.

BrandName.title: Brand Name
BrandName.description: Optional Informz Brand Name (embedded in SOAP request body as <Brand id="NNNN">Brand Name</Brand> for display/logging purposes).
